patent.title: Using wicking material to collect urine from a male for transport
patent.family_note: Holdout INT-5. Prefer this patent over US10226376 in same PureWick v Sage case because royalty is single-patent; ’376/’989 share lost profits.

knowledge_origin.description: PureWick assignee; inventorship genealogy not reconstructed.

technology.problem: Collect urine from a male without catheterizing while enabling continuous transport.
technology.mechanism: Flexible porous layer + wicking material + impermeable layer forming chamber with vacuum port and penis-head receptacle.

value_carriers.name: Sage PrimoFit (accused male external urine collection device)
value_carriers.description: Court found PrimoFit infringes claims 1 and 2 of US10376407.

value_metrics.metric_name: court-awarded reasonable royalty for infringement of US10376407
value_metrics.note: Single-patent royalty. Dispute-specific; not intrinsic price. Ongoing 6.5% royalty on later PrimoFit sales also ordered.

gaps.description: Royalty is litigation-context; ongoing rate may change; not a market license schedule.
No field-normalized quality score beyond infringement.

notes: Holdout INT-5. T0=2026-10-13. Single-patent court E3+E4+E5 → R5. Judgment≠auto R5 without E3/exact_patent metric—those are present. Formal V0.7; not V0.8.
